title: Create a complete test deployment package for Digital Exhibition
goal: Package the Vue frontend and existing Feishu server proxy as one test-deployable Node application with explicit non-secret configuration.
target_user: The project owner deploying Digital Exhibition to the test environment.
in_scope: Standalone Node test server serving dist and existing /api/v1 middleware
Non-secret serverConfig with /test2 base and runtime settings
Environment variable template for Feishu secrets
Build/package/start scripts and Nginx reverse-proxy example
Automated startup, static-route, API-route, and secret-exclusion verification
out_of_scope: Deploying or changing the external test server
Embedding credentials in dist or serverConfig
Changing Feishu upstream hosts or business operation behavior
success_metric: A generated test package starts with one documented command, serves /test2, handles /api/v1 through the existing proxy, and contains no secrets.
